# Bridge UI map

<!-- Generated by node scripts/clubhouse/bridge-ui-map.mjs from config/bridge/contracts.json. Do not edit. -->

Every control and state on the Bridge's own screens, by its `BR-` code (plan §6, owner decision D4). Each code sits on its element as `data-br`. The four states repeat on every screen: xx90 loading, xx91 empty, xx92 failed to load, xx93 no signal yet.

| Screen | Name | Route | Codes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B02 | Pages | /admin/clubhouse | 14 |
| B03 | Controls | /admin/clubhouse/controls | 11 |
| B04 | Actions | /admin/clubhouse/actions | 12 |
| B05 | Codes | /admin/clubhouse/codes | 14 |
| B11 | Drift | /admin/clubhouse/drift | 8 |
| B12 | Readiness | /admin/clubhouse/readiness | 13 |
| B13 | Duet desk | /admin/clubhouse/duet | 12 |
| B14 | Command palette | ⌘K, every /admin screen | 6 |
| B15 | Shell | every /admin screen | 7 |

97 codes in all.

## B02 Pages

| Code | Label | Does | In code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BR-0201 | Page row | Opens the dossier | `BR.pages.row` |
| BR-0202 | Sort | Failures · coverage · never seen · gates | `BR.pages.sort` |
| BR-0203 | View rail | Overview · States · Controls · Actions · Contract · Phone · History | `BR.pages.viewRail` |
| BR-0204 | Matrix cell | Opens that ID's dossier (B05) | `BR.pages.matrixCell` |
| BR-0205 | Category label | Shows that category alone, with its default and exception note | `BR.pages.categoryLabel` |
| BR-0206 | Show | All · fired · never seen · failures | `BR.pages.show` |
| BR-0207 | Doc link | Opens the doc on GitHub at the live SHA | `BR.pages.docLink` |
| BR-0208 | Force this state | Opens /clubhouse-preview/<screen>?state=… in an iPhone frame (D6) | `BR.pages.forceState` |
| BR-0209 | Context pack | The whole page's pack, to B13 | `BR.pages.pack` |
| BR-0210 | Copy | The page report | `BR.pages.copy` |
| BR-0290 | Loading | A skeleton shaped like the screen (xx90) | `BR.pages.loading` |
| BR-0291 | Empty | Nothing in this scope, with the reason (xx91) | `BR.pages.empty` |
| BR-0292 | Failed to load | The read failed; Try again re-requests it (xx92) | `BR.pages.failed` |
| BR-0293 | No signal yet | Live data is not reaching the Bridge yet, so nothing is claimed (xx93) | `BR.pages.noSignal` |
